chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Rabie al-Musli and Ziyad ibn Abi al-Hallal, mentioned it from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

On the night of the nineteenth of the month of Ramadan is the Ordainment (al-Taqdir), and on the night of the twenty-first is the Execution (al-Qada'), and on the night of the twenty-third is the Confirmation of what will occur in the year until its like [next year]. For Allah, Exalted is His Praise, does whatever He wills among His creatures.

key_terms.إِبْرَامُ: The Confirmation, sealing, or finalization of the year's events.
key_terms.التَّقْدِيرُ: The Ordainment or initial decree of divine matters.
key_terms.الْقَضَاءُ: The Execution or implementation of the decreed matters.
key_terms.لَيْلَةِ إِحْدَى وَ عِشْرِينَ: The night of the 21st of Ramadan.
key_terms.لَيْلَةِ تِسْعَ عَشْرَةَ: The night of the 19th of Ramadan.
key_terms.لَيْلَةِ ثَلَاثٍ وَ عِشْرِينَ: The night of the 23rd of Ramadan.

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between Taqdir, Qada, and Ibram in the context of the Nights of Qadr?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi delineates a tripartite theological framework for the latter ten nights of Ramadan, distinguishing between the initial decree (Taqdir) on the 19th, the execution of that decree (Qada) on the 21st, and the final sealing (Ibram) of the year's affairs on the 23rd. This specific progression reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the dynamic nature of divine will, where the 23rd night serves as the culmination where the year's destiny is firmly established, reinforcing the belief in Allah's absolute sovereignty over creation.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Rabie Al Musly and Ziyad Bin Abu Al Hallal, mentioning it from a man, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘During the night of the 19<sup>th</sup> of a Month of Ramazan is the Ordainment, and during the night of the 21<sup>st</sup> is the accomplishment, and during the night of the 23<sup>rd</sup> is confirmation of what would be transpiring during the year up it its like (next Night of Pre-determination). For Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Majestic is His<sup>azwj</sup> Praise, is that He<sup>azwj</sup> Does whatever He<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires to regarding His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures’.
en.sarwar: 12. A number of our people have narrated, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Rabi’ al-Musliy and Ziyad ibn abu al- Hallal who have narrated it, from a man who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

during the nineteenth night of the month of Ramadan is measurement and determination; in the twenty-first night is decision; and in the twenty-third night is verification of what has to take place during the coming year up to the next night of destiny. Allah, glorious is whose praise, does whatever He wills about His creature.”
